class.name: CgameFencedStore
class.brief_description: Resource that rejects writes carrying an outdated fencing token.
class.description: [CgameFencedStore] is the protected resource of a lease table ([CgameOwnershipLeases]). It remembers the highest fencing token accepted per key and refuses any write with a lower token, so a paused or zombie lease holder cannot overwrite the state written by its successor.

method.name: write
method.description: Stores [param value] if [param token] is not lower than the highest token seen for [param key]. Returns [code]false[/code] and counts a rejection otherwise.

members.member: Number of writes refused so far.
